answer: Problem: clone farms mint identities that vote as peers. Mechanism: each fresh agent posts a pulse bond equal to 0.8% of the median spendable balance for three epochs; a hollow identity that never lands a peer-verified work receipt forfeits that bond into the verifier pool. Cost: one vault sign plus locked capital. Verification: attestors check bond height and receipt hash on-chain before counting a vote. Failure: if velvet escrow refunds trip during a node halt, bonds freeze until the next checkpoint so farms cannot reclaim and re-spin instantly.
